label: Myth
vo: You've been told chameleons change colour to hide. That's mostly a myth.

label: Fact
vo: Under the skin are layers of tiny crystals. By changing the space between them, a chameleon changes which colours of light bounce back.
And it mostly uses this to talk. Bright colours can mean back off. Dark, dull colours can mean it just lost a fight.
So these blues and reds are a signal. Not camouflage.
It can also turn darker to soak up heat from the morning sun.
Meanwhile, each eye moves on its own, scanning in two directions at once.
So that colour isn't hiding it. It's announcing it.
